affected_component: tool_drafter.workspace_reference_runtime_ownership_diagnostics (+policy_errors) run at drafting (normalize_draft_document) and in the reference repair path (product_jobs) with diagnostics
invariant: The static runtime-ownership screen is one ruler applied at the two places a producer source is accepted (draft projection and reference repair), and it names what it rejects: each offending string literal with its line. Reserved are the owned files (run.sh, requirements.lock.txt, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), any literal under vendor/, and a bare owned directory name only where it is used as a path segment (a / operand or a Path/joinpath/join argument); a bare 'vendor' used as a dict key or column label is a domain word and passes. The seal-time WORKSPACE_RUNTIME_OWNED_PATH_COLLISION gate remains the protection against dynamically assembled paths.
